label: H.R. 4758
title: Homeowner Energy Freedom Act

items.snippet: This bill repeals the Department of Energy's (1) high-efficiency electric home rebate program for certain electrification projects in low- or…
…households, (2) state-based home energy efficiency contractor training grants, and (3) assistance for states and local governments to adopt specified building energy codes.
